steps.title: Assembled the resume with 2 verified bullets

lines.original: Built a shipment tracking API in Python and FastAPI that serves 1.2 million requests a day
Cut median API response time from 420 ms to 150 ms by adding Redis caching and fixing slow PostgreSQL queries
Wrote a nightly job that reconciles 300,000 delivery records and flags mismatches for the operations team
Added unit and integration tests with pytest, raising coverage of the billing module from 35% to 80%
Reviewed pull requests for a team of 5 engineers and wrote the team's API style guide
Developed internal dashboards in React and TypeScript used by 40 support agents
Moved 12 cron jobs from a single server to Docker containers deployed through GitHub Actions
Fixed a data export bug that had caused duplicate invoices for 3 enterprise customers
Trained a gradient boosting model on 6 months of public GPS data to predict bus arrival times within 2 minutes on average
Served predictions through a small Flask app and wrote a README with setup steps
Frameworks and tools: FastAPI, Flask, React, Docker, GitHub Actions, Redis, PostgreSQL, pytest
